#### Dashboard JSON Input

```{bash}

aws quicksight describe-dashboard-permissions \
  --aws-account-id $ACCOUNT_ID \
  --dashboard-id $SOURCE_DASHBOARD_ID1 \
  --region $REGION \
  --query 'Permissions' \
  > permissions1.json
  
  aws quicksight describe-dashboard-permissions \
  --aws-account-id $ACCOUNT_ID \
  --dashboard-id $SOURCE_DASHBOARD_ID2 \
  --region $REGION \
  --query 'Permissions' \
  > permissions2.json


```

### Create Dashboard from Definition

```{bash eval=FALSE}

# Pull the full dashboard definition
aws quicksight describe-dashboard-definition \
  --dashboard-id "$SOURCE_DASHBOARD_ID1" \
  --aws-account-id "$ACCOUNT_ID" \
  --region "$REGION" \
  --output json > full_dashboard_def1.json

# Extract required components
jq '.Definition' full_dashboard_def1.json > dashboard_definition1.json

```


```{bash}

aws quicksight create-dashboard \
  --aws-account-id "$ACCOUNT_ID" \
  --dashboard-id "$NEW_DASHBOARD_ID1" \
  --name "$NEW_DASHBOARD_NAME1" \
  --definition file://dashboard_definition1.json \
  --permissions file://permissions1.json \
  --dashboard-publish-options '{"AdHocFilteringOption":{"AvailabilityStatus":"ENABLED"}}' \
  --region "$REGION"
  
```

```{bash}

# Temporary files
PLACEHOLDER_FILE="placeholders.json"
SOURCE_ENTITY_FILE="source_entity.json"

# Required inputs
ACCOUNT_ID="535362115856"
REGION="us-east-1"
ANALYSIS_ID="44adce9f-4223-47d5-805c-85b760a682db"
DASHBOARD_ID="db668034-805d-44f1-a362-9487acf7c676"

# Fetch dataset identifier declarations from dashboard definition
echo "Fetching dataset references from dashboard definition $DASHBOARD_ID..."
aws quicksight describe-dashboard-definition \
  --aws-account-id "$ACCOUNT_ID" \
  --dashboard-id "$DASHBOARD_ID" \
  --region "$REGION" \
  --query 'Definition.DataSetIdentifierDeclarations' \
  --output json > "$PLACEHOLDER_FILE"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Failed to fetch dataset identifier declarations from dashboard definition."
  exit 1
fi

# Build source_entity.json
echo "Building final $SOURCE_ENTITY_FILE..."

jq -n \
  --arg analysis_arn "arn:aws:quicksight:$REGION:$ACCOUNT_ID:analysis/$ANALYSIS_ID" \
  --slurpfile refs "$PLACEHOLDER_FILE" '
{
  SourceAnalysis: {
    Arn: $analysis_arn,
    DataSetReferences: ($refs[0] | map({
      DataSetPlaceholder: .Identifier,
      DataSetArn: .DataSetArn
    }))
  }
}' > "$SOURCE_ENTITY_FILE"

echo "Created $SOURCE_ENTITY_FILE"



```
